figurative_meaning_en: Derisively referring to a person with dark and ugly appearance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো একটা চিকণকালা, কারো দিকে তাকানো যায় না।
গ্রামের সেই চিকণকালা লোকটাকে সবাই এড়িয়ে চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's such a sooty black, you can't even look at him.
Everyone in the village avoids that dark and ugly fellow.
note: This idiom reflects color-based prejudices common in traditional Bengali expressions.
